sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops AppsFlyer, Flurry, comScore, Firebase Analytics and Facebook from collecting usage data.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Removes ads from the feed, app open, interstitial and rewarded placements, and the sponsor banner on the launch screen.
Removes advertiser banners under posts and the VIP package and advertising offers on the profile.
Allows screenshots and screen recording on every screen.
